items.q: Actually the first time Bird came up was sort of a mistake. Some fraternity or social club had booked Charlie Ventura who was hot then for their dance at the school.

ctx.x: And no, these guys would come on their off night like Monday or Tuesday would be an off night. They’d come up in the early evening before they went to work and so forth. Actually the first time Bird came up was sort of a mistake. Some fraternity or social club had booked Charlie Ventura who was hot then for their dance at the school.
